final:
title_of(html: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() <= html.char_count()
  ex title_of("<title>Example</title>") == "Example"
  ex title_of("no title") == ""
  let parts = html.split("<title>")
  let after_open = parts.get(1) else return ""
  let subparts = after_open.split("</title>")
  let after_close = subparts.get(1) else return ""
  copy subparts[0]

test_title_of() =
  assert title_of("<title>Example</title>") == "Example"
  assert title_of("no title") == ""
  assert title_of("<title>Hello World</title>") == "Hello World"
  assert title_of("<title>no closing tag") == ""
  assert title_of("no opening tag</title>") == ""
